name: technical-team
description: A stack-agnostic engineering team of 14 Claude Code agents (including a UI/UX designer) led by a tech lead: tiered pipelines, quality gates G1–G4, a run kit of operating skills, a live-preview skill that tests the running app in a real browser, workflow commands, a `.team/` workspace with one file per work item and role, and an HR process for hiring domain specialists. Per-role permissions are instructions in the agent files plus each agent's tool list; no hook enforces them.
